versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: Observe 〚ye〛 how the trees cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit: wherefore give ye heed ⌜and know⌝ with regard to all ⌜His works⌝, and recognize how He that liveth for ever hath made them so.
verses.text_hr: Promatrajte 〚dakle〛 kako se stabla odijevaju zelenim lišćem i donose plod. Zato pomno gledajte ⌜i spoznajte⌝ sva ⌜Njegova djela⌝ te uvidite kako ih je načinio Onaj koji živi dovijeka.

verses.text_en: And ⌜all⌝ His works go on ⌜thus⌝ from year to year ⌜for ever⌝, and all the tasks ⌜which⌝ they accomplish for Him, and ⌜their tasks⌝ change not, but according as 〚God〛 hath ordained so is it done.
verses.text_hr: I ⌜sva⌝ Njegova djela traju ⌜tako⌝ iz godine u godinu ⌜dovijeka⌝; sve zadaće ⌜koje⌝ za Njega izvršavaju ne mijenjaju se, nego se vrši onako kako je 〚Bog〛 odredio.

verses.text_en: And behold how the sea and the rivers in like manner accomplish ⌜and change not⌝ their tasks ⌜from His commandments⌝.
verses.text_hr: Pogledajte kako more i rijeke na isti način izvršavaju ⌜i ne mijenjaju⌝ svoje zadaće ⌜prema Njegovim zapovijedima⌝.

verses.text_en:
But ye—ye have not been steadfast, nor done the commandments of the Lord,
But ye have turned away and spoken proud and hard words
With your impure mouths against His greatness.
Oh, ye hard-hearted, ye shall find no peace.
verses.text_hr:
Ali vi — vi niste bili postojani niti ste vršili Gospodinove zapovijedi,
nego ste se odvratili i svojim nečistim ustima
govorili ohole i grube riječi protiv Njegove veličine.
O tvrdokorni, nećete naći mira.

verses.text_en:
Therefore shall ye execrate your days,
And the years of your life shall perish,
And ⌜the years of your destruction⌝ shall be multiplied in eternal execration,
And ye shall find no mercy.
verses.text_hr:
Zato ćete proklinjati svoje dane,
godine će vašega života propasti,
a ⌜godine vaše propasti⌝ umnožit će se u vječnom prokletstvu
i nećete naći milosrđa.

verses.text_en:
[6a] In those days ye shall make your names an eternal execration unto all the righteous,

[6b] And by you shall ⌜all⌝ who curse, curse.

[6c] ⌜And all⌝ the sinners ⌜and godless⌝ shall imprecate by you,

[6d] ⌜And all the ... shall rejoice,

[6e] And there shall be forgiveness of sins,

[6f] And every mercy and peace and forbearance:

[6g] There shall be salvation unto them, a goodly light.

[6i] And for all of you sinners there shall be no salvation,

[6j] But on you all shall abide a curse⌝.
verses.text_hr:
[6a] U one dane učinit ćete svoja imena vječnim prokletstvom među svim pravednicima.

[6b] Vama će se ⌜svi⌝ koji proklinju služiti u svojim kletvama.

[6c] ⌜Svi⌝ grešnici ⌜i bezbožnici⌝ proklinjat će vas.

[6d] ⌜A svi će se ... radovati.

[6e] Bit će oproštenja grijeha,

[6f] svakoga milosrđa, mira i strpljivosti.

[6g] Njima će doći spasenje, divna svjetlost.

[6i] Ali za sve vas grešnike neće biti spasenja,

[6j] nego će na svima vama ostati prokletstvo⌝.

verses.text_en:
[7c] And for you, the godless, there shall be a curse.

[7a] But for the elect there shall be light and grace and peace,

[7b] And they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text_hr:
[7c] A za vas bezbožnike bit će prokletstvo.

[7a] Ali za izabrane bit će svjetlosti, milosti i mira,

[7b] i oni će baštiniti zemlju.

verses.text_en:
And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom,
And they shall all live and never again sin,
Either through ungodliness or through pride;
But they who are wise shall be humble.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će izabranima biti darovana mudrost;
svi će živjeti i više nikada neće griješiti,
ni bezbožnošću ni ohološću,
nego će mudri biti ponizni.

verses.text_en:
And they shall not again transgress,
Nor shall they sin all the days of their life,
Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath,
But they shall complete the number of the days of their life.
And their lives shall be increased in peace,
And the years of their joy shall be multiplied,
In eternal gladness and peace,
All the days of their life.
verses.text_hr:
Više neće prestupati
niti će griješiti u sve dane svojega života.
Neće umirati od (božanske) srdžbe ili gnjeva,
nego će dovršiti puni broj dana svojega života.
Život će im se produžiti u miru,
godine njihove radosti umnožit će se
u vječnoj radosti i miru
kroz sve dane njihova života.
